title: Quadrilles, cakewalk revivals and French spoken at home
summary: Arthur loves dancing; old-timers still perform quadrilles and cakewalks; his family spoke French at home.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets

blocks.x: Do you remember as far back when they used to use the quadrilles?

I remember the quadrilles. I remember the cakewalk. But I was too young I didn't do those dances. No I didn't even try. I was too young for those dances. We had them did recently at Peter Clever's church. They got quite a few of the old timers that still left that can do the cakewalk and the quadrilles. And they are very good.
I knew they had some quadrilles dancers at one of the Creole festivals.
Right. Those are the people I am speaking about. Same group. Yeah they were out in the park one time when Piku played. Yeah that's right. At Burry Guard Square. At Burry Guard Square. Yeah.
They had a television program with Dave Garroway about three years ago. And then Lizzie Miles and Paula Barberin's band and all of that. They had the group then. Now she dances that too Lizzie Miles.

Oh yes. She dances that chair. And they got a group right here. They dance that's a kid. They dance that's a kid walking or a quadrilles in the Fiesta. They got a 16th of... No they just had it. They had a dance right here at the Autocrats about two weeks ago. Oh yeah. Oh yeah. Oh yeah. Oh yeah. Oh yeah. Oh yeah.
Oh yeah. Oh yeah. But they got some of the old dancers from them days. Yeah they got some of them left that can still dance to. Oh yeah.

They look real good when I saw them. Yeah they were real good at the square. Yeah they were real good at the square. Yeah. Very interesting. Yeah. Nice. Well I was going to ask when you were a boy and your family were... that name sounds like it's French. The Vien, is that French or... French. Did you all speak French or Creole in the family? My mother spoke French.
My daddy did. Well it was... it was... well my mother spoke good French. And I had a grandmother spoke good French. And my father did. But we had... you can cut it off. Alright. Thank you.
